## Per-Province Data Files

- [Azad Kashmir](https://github.com/open-admin-data/pakistan-administrative-divisions/blob/main/docs/llms-full/azad-kashmir-pk1.txt) — 10 districts, 32 tehsils
- [Balochistan](https://github.com/open-admin-data/pakistan-administrative-divisions/blob/main/docs/llms-full/balochistan-pk2.txt) — 35 districts, 103 tehsils
- [Gilgit Baltistan](https://github.com/open-admin-data/pakistan-administrative-divisions/blob/main/docs/llms-full/gilgit-baltistan-pk3.txt) — 14 districts, 24 tehsils
- [Islamabad](https://github.com/open-admin-data/pakistan-administrative-divisions/blob/main/docs/llms-full/islamabad-pk4.txt) — 1 districts, 1 tehsils
- [Khyber Pakhtunkhwa](https://github.com/open-admin-data/pakistan-administrative-divisions/blob/main/docs/llms-full/khyber-pakhtunkhwa-pk5.txt) — 35 districts, 153 tehsils
- [Punjab](https://github.com/open-admin-data/pakistan-administrative-divisions/blob/main/docs/llms-full/punjab-pk6.txt) — 36 districts, 139 tehsils
- [Sindh](https://github.com/open-admin-data/pakistan-administrative-divisions/blob/main/docs/llms-full/sindh-pk7.txt) — 29 districts, 125 tehsils
